title: Cast time
wikitext:
'''Cast time''' is a [[keyword]] and refers to animated action of performing [[skill]] and is counted in seconds. If cast time ends, [[effect]] of skill is started. Usually during skill [[effect]] next cast could be started.
[[Category:Keywords]]

==Skill gems==
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_levels
|join=items._pageID=skill_levels._pageID
|where=
    skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell"
    AND skill.cast_time > ""
|level=yes
|int=yes
|dex=yes
|str=yes
|cast_time=yes
}}
